title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

title: American Bitcoin’s $126M profit masks mining pressure as rivals turn to AI

title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
summary: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
summary: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.

title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
summary: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
summary: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
summary: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.

title: Paraguay president resigns after collapse of Ueno digital bank
summary: Santiago Peña stepped down amid mounting scrutiny over his former ties to Ueno Bank’s parent company, as the lender’s collapse left millions of customers unable to access their funds.

title: Bitcoin crashes 6% to 7-week low as US stocks erase election gains

title: Blockchain is ‘perfect solution’ for AI agent trust, VeChain CEO says
